clues: This city stands on both banks of a wide river in the north centre of its land, in the east of Europe. It is one of the oldest cities of the east.
In winter the wide river here freezes, and folks fish through holes in the ice. In summer they sunbathe on a beach by the same river.
Viking rulers took this city in the mid 800s and made it a capital. It led Rus, the first state of the East Slavs.
St Sophia Cathedral, raised by Prince Yaroslav the Wise, still stands in this city. It has stood here for about a thousand years.
This city stayed the capital of Ukraine when the land won its freedom in 1991. It is still the nation's biggest and richest city.
